# zizmor, for the workflow audit in .github/workflows/security.yml, installed
# there with
#   pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: -r .github/zizmor-requirements.txt
# zizmor is one self-contained binary wheel with no Python dependencies.
#
# An exact version and the sha256 of every linux x86_64 and aarch64 wheel,
# as PyPI's JSON API lists them for that release. Not edited by hand:
# scripts/check-pins.sh tracks it, and scripts/bump-pins.sh rewrites the
# version and hashes together, at least seven days after the release, on a
# pin-bump PR. scripts/lint.sh reads the version from here for its local run.
zizmor==1.30.1 \
    --hash=sha256:92906f448365672ebb657fb50d36f997290a3aaba8cac723214741ea9054845d \
    --hash=sha256:eee12266b793cb87ad4a7e3af2e72404f8a63e3de5eb099b80bf7b1cfd232a8e
